difficulty.reason: Stripe Connect OAuth requires setting up a Stripe platform account, enabling Connect in test mode, and completing standard business verification before moving to live charges.

timeEstimate.approvalWait: Instant in Test Mode; 1-3 business days for Live Mode merchant verification
timeEstimate.notes: Test mode OAuth credentials are available immediately without business verification.

requirements.text: Valid HTTPS Redirect URI configured in Stripe Connect settings
Published Terms of Service and Privacy Policy URLs

steps.title: Enable Connect in the Stripe Dashboard
steps.description: Log into the Stripe Dashboard, navigate to Settings > Connect settings, and enable OAuth onboarding for connected accounts.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Branding
steps.description: Add your development and production HTTPS callback URLs and upload your company logo.

steps.title: Obtain Connect Client ID and Secret API Keys
steps.description: Retrieve the Connect Client ID (ca_...) and your secret API keys (sk_test_... / sk_live_...) to configure in your AI agent environment variables.

blockers.problem: Using Live mode credentials before completing identity verification.
blockers.solution: Use test mode credentials (ca_... with sk_test_...) during development to bypass merchant identity verification.

blockers.problem: CSRF token mismatch during OAuth callback.
blockers.solution: Always pass and validate a cryptographic state parameter in the authorization redirect URL.

agentCanDo: Construct Stripe Connect authorization URLs with client_id, scope, and state parameters
Execute automated Stripe API calls using connected account headers (Stripe-Account)
developerMustDo: Complete legal business identity verification for live charges

managedOption.managedSufficientWhen: Using a managed provider like Composio when connecting an AI agent to read invoices, subscriptions, or customer data without managing platform liabilities. Note: This tool was built for a Composio assignment, and Composio sells managed OAuth.
managedOption.customRequiredWhen: Building a custom marketplace or platform taking application fees on financial transactions directly via custom Stripe Connect.

claims.claim: Stripe Connect supports OAuth 2.0 onboarding for connected accounts in both test and live environments.

openQuestions: Are there specific third-party security audits (like CASA) mandated by Stripe for public Connect platforms?
